import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def eq(actual, expected):
 assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)

base_req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'}}
base_pol={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':False}
base_ev=[{'source':'S1','claim':'c','value':{'z':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'},'verified':False}]
orig=copy.deepcopy((base_req,base_ev,base_pol))
eq(evaluate(base_req,base_ev,base_pol), {'status':'supported','value':{'z':2,'a':1},'sources':['S1'],'unknowns':[]})
assert (base_req,base_ev,base_pol)==orig
eq(evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},base_ev,base_pol), {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})
eq(evaluate(base_req,base_ev,{**base_pol,'require_verified':True}), {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
ev=[{'source':'Z','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'}},{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'}},{'source':'W','claim':'c','value':3,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'},'withdrawn':True}]
eq(evaluate(base_req,ev,base_pol), {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['A','Z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
ev=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'},'supersedes':['old']}]
eq(evaluate(base_req,ev,base_pol), {'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
eq(evaluate({'claim':'f','conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'}},[{'source':'F','claim':'f','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':'x'}}],base_pol), {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['F'],'unknowns':[]})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
eq(report,[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests])
assert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report)
print('all checks passed')
